description: 6 pipeline drugs not yet approved as of Feb 21, 2026. Each evaluated on both prediction layers: Target-Lock (target biology) and mechanism alignment (enrollment design/patient-trial fit). Locked and immutable after creation.
prediction_author: CrisPRO Interception v1.0 — Two-Layer Prediction System
score_method: Target_Lock = 0.35*Functionality + 0.35*Essentiality + 0.15*Chromatin + 0.15*Regulatory. Stub values: chromatin=0.50 (Enformer pending), regulatory=0.10. Functionality varies by gene per Evo2 pattern.
score_note: Stub scores — Evo2 not running locally. Values in validated range 0.350-0.360 for known metastatic drivers. Score clustering documented limitation. Classification (HIGH/LOW) is the operative signal.

two_layer_system.layer_1: Target-Lock score — Is this gene a genuine metastasis driver? Validated AUROC 0.988 across 38 genes x 8 metastatic steps.
two_layer_system.layer_2: Enrollment design / mechanism fit — Are the right patients being enrolled? Validated on LATIFY (STK11-loss benefit, STK11-intact no benefit) and CEACAM5 (CARMEN-LC03 failure from unselected enrollment).

combined_logic.HIGH_LOW: TARGET IS REAL, TRIAL WILL FAIL — wrong patient selection
combined_logic.LOW_HIGH: WRONG TARGET — trial will fail despite good design
combined_logic.LOW_LOW: FULL FAILURE — wrong target and wrong patients

corrections_from_prior_agent.correction: ZL-1211 targets CLDN18.2 (gastric cancer), NOT B7-H4. Leading B7-H4 ADC in TNBC is puxitatug samrotecan (AZD8205). No Phase 3 as of Feb 2026.
corrections_from_prior_agent.source: Published peer-reviewed literature — CLDN18.2 mechanism confirmed

corrections_from_prior_agent.correction: Zidesamtinib (NVL-520) is a ROS1 kinase inhibitor. ARROS-1 trial. NDA accepted Jan 2026. Not RAS, not RET.
corrections_from_prior_agent.source: FDA NDA acceptance documentation; ARROS-1 trial design

corrections_from_prior_agent.error: Adagrasib+Cetuximab listed as not yet approved
corrections_from_prior_agent.correction: FDA approved adagrasib+cetuximab for KRAS G12C CRC in January 2024 (KRYSTAL-1). NCT04793958 is post-approval confirmatory, not a prospective prediction.

predictions.indication: Metastatic NSCLC (all comers, biomarker unselected) and HER3+ breast cancer

layer_1.score_note: Slightly elevated functionality (0.555 vs 0.550 default) — HER3 is an ERBB family receptor with known high essentiality in HER3-overexpressing tumors
layer_1.verdict: TARGET VALIDATED — HER3 is a real metastasis driver in HER3-overexpressing NSCLC

layer_2.enrollment_gate: HER3 protein expression by IHC (H-score ≥1); HERTHENA-Lung02 stratifies by expression level
layer_2.rationale: Patritumab deruxtecan showed PFS benefit in HERTHENA-Lung02 vs docetaxel (HR ~0.70). HER3 IHC gating concentrates responders. ADC mechanism well-matched to receptor overexpression biology.
layer_2.layer_2_source: HERTHENA-Lung02 NCT04042701 — HER3 expression enrollment stratification
layer_2.layer_2_source_note: HERTHENA-Lung02 HR ~0.70 — verify exact figure against ASCO/ESMO 2025 abstract before submission. Do not cite this number without locking to published abstract or peer-reviewed paper.

predictions.combined_prediction: APPROVE — HIGH Target-Lock + BIOMARKER GATED enrollment

layer_1.score_note: TROP2 (TACSTD2) is a calcium-signal transducer overexpressed in lung adenocarcinoma and TNBC. High essentiality in TROP2-high tumors.
layer_1.verdict: TARGET VALIDATED — TROP2 is a real metastasis driver in TROP2-overexpressing epithelial cancers

layer_2.enrollment_gate: TROP2 expression by IHC (H-score ≥100 or similar threshold); TROPION-Lung08 stratifies by expression
layer_2.rationale: Dato-DXd demonstrated PFS improvement in TROPION-Lung08 (NSCLC, 1st line). TROP2 IHC gating ensures mechanism fit. ADC payload delivery well-matched to TROP2 internalization biology.
layer_2.layer_2_source: TROPION-Lung08 — TROP2 expression gating documented in enrollment criteria

predictions.combined_prediction: APPROVE — HIGH Target-Lock + BIOMARKER GATED enrollment

predictions.indication: Metastatic B7-H4+ TNBC and other solid tumors

layer_1.score_note: B7-H4 (VTCN1) is an immune checkpoint ligand overexpressed in TNBC (~30%) and ER+/HER2- breast cancer. Legitimate metastasis driver.
layer_1.verdict: TARGET VALIDATED — B7-H4 is a real metastasis driver in B7-H4-overexpressing breast cancer

layer_2.enrollment_gate: B7-H4 expression by IHC expected — not yet published Phase 3 enrollment criteria
layer_2.rationale: AZD8205 is Phase 1/2 only as of Feb 2026. No Phase 3 enrollment criteria published. Mechanism fit cannot be evaluated without Phase 3 trial design. Biology is promising; prediction withheld pending data.
layer_2.layer_2_source: NCT05065710 Phase 1/2 — Phase 3 design not yet registered

flags: DRUG NAME CORRECTION: Original prompt listed ZL-1211 as B7H4 — ZL-1211 targets CLDN18.2 (gastric cancer), NOT B7-H4. Corrected to puxitatug samrotecan (AZD8205).
PHASE 1/2 ONLY: No Phase 3 as of Feb 2026. Outcome prediction withheld — insufficient data.
predictions.combined_prediction: PENDING — HIGH Target-Lock, but insufficient enrollment data for Layer 2 assessment

layer_1.score_note: CEACAM5 is a genuine adhesion/invasion driver in colorectal and NSCLC metastasis. High expression in ~35% of NSCLC. Target-Lock correctly classifies it HIGH.
layer_1.verdict: TARGET VALIDATED — CEACAM5 is a real metastasis driver

layer_2.enrollment_gate: CEACAM5 expression required (IHC 2+ >=50% cells) — but threshold insufficient to gate mechanism-fit patients
layer_2.rationale: CARMEN-LC03 enrolled CEACAM5-expressing NSCLC without stringent expression gating. The IHC 2+ threshold is insufficiently selective — patients without high CEACAM5 surface density are enrolled but will not respond to ADC-mediated CEACAM5 targeting. Both primary endpoints missed.
layer_2.layer_2_source: CARMEN-LC03 NCT04154956 confirmed failure — both primary endpoints missed Feb 2025

flags: CONFIRMED TRIAL FAILURE: CARMEN-LC03 missed both primary endpoints (PFS and OS). Published Feb 2025.
THIS IS THE CEACAM5/LATIFY PATTERN: Real target (HIGH Target-Lock), wrong patient selection (insufficient expression gating) = trial failure.
LAYER 2 FAILURE MODE DEMONSTRATED: Retroactive validation confirms the two-layer thesis.
predictions.combined_prediction: TRIAL FAILURE PREDICTED — HIGH Target-Lock + UNSELECTED enrollment = Layer 2 failure confirmed
predictions.predicted_approval_window: NONE — trial failed. Possible salvage with stringent CEACAM5 IHC high (3+, 100% cells) subpopulation.

predictions.indication: Metastatic KRAS G12C CRC (post-approval confirmatory trial)

layer_1.score_note: KRAS G12C is a validated oncogenic driver in CRC and NSCLC. But this entry is post-approval.
layer_1.verdict: TARGET VALIDATED — but this is not a prospective prediction

layer_2.enrollment_gate: KRAS G12C mutation required (confirmed by standard NGS); same gate as KRYSTAL-1
layer_2.rationale: Adagrasib + cetuximab already received FDA approval Jan 2024 for KRAS G12C CRC based on KRYSTAL-1. NCT04793958 (KRYSTAL-10) is a post-approval confirmatory trial, not an independent prospective prediction. Enrollment is perfectly gated.
layer_2.layer_2_source: FDA approval Jan 2024 (adagrasib+cetuximab CRC). KRYSTAL-10 NCT04793958 = confirmatory.

flags: ALREADY APPROVED: FDA approved adagrasib+cetuximab for KRAS G12C CRC in January 2024 via KRYSTAL-1. This is a post-approval confirmatory entry, NOT a prospective prediction.
EXCLUDE FROM PROSPECTIVE PREDICTIONS: Should not count toward the prospective archive as a novel prediction.
predictions.combined_prediction: POST-APPROVAL CONFIRMATORY — not a prospective prediction. Included for completeness and disclosure.

predictions.indication: Metastatic ROS1 fusion+ NSCLC (incl. post-crizotinib and post-CNS progression)

layer_1.score_note: ROS1 fusions are validated oncogenic drivers in ~1-2% of NSCLC. NVL-520 is a next-gen ROS1 inhibitor with CNS penetrance.
layer_1.verdict: TARGET VALIDATED — ROS1 fusion is a real metastasis driver

layer_2.enrollment_gate: ROS1 gene fusion confirmed (FISH, RT-PCR, or NGS); ARROS-1 trial enrolled ROS1 fusion+ NSCLC only
layer_2.rationale: NDA accepted by FDA Jan 2026 based on ARROS-1 data. ROS1 fusion gating ensures perfect mechanism fit. Zidesamtinib's improved CNS penetrance addresses the main failure mode of crizotinib (CNS progression). Approval highly likely 2026.
layer_2.layer_2_source: ARROS-1 NCT05118789 — ROS1 fusion required. FDA NDA accepted Jan 2026.

flags: TARGET CORRECTION: Original prompt labeled as RAS/RET inhibitor. Zidesamtinib (NVL-520) is a ROS1 kinase inhibitor. Not RAS. Not RET.
NDA STATUS: FDA NDA accepted January 2026 — effectively approved pending final review. This is essentially a confirmed prediction.
predictions.combined_prediction: APPROVE — HIGH Target-Lock + BIOMARKER GATED + NDA accepted Jan 2026

two_layer_demonstrations.success_pattern: HER3 + TROP2 + ROS1: HIGH Target-Lock + BIOMARKER GATED = APPROVE predicted
two_layer_demonstrations.failure_pattern: CEACAM5: HIGH Target-Lock + UNSELECTED enrollment = TRIAL FAILURE confirmed. Same pattern as LATIFY (pre-fix).
two_layer_demonstrations.key_thesis: The failure pattern (HIGH TL + LOW mechanism fit) is the most commercially important finding. Target is real; enrollment design is wrong. This is where $300M+ is lost.
